notes: Product TYPES (not SKUs). A query resolves to one or more types; each store gets a presence probability per type from category-priors.v1.json plus evidence. Names in en/de/es are aliases automatically. Keep aliases specific: a short ambiguous alias (e.g. 'birne' = pear AND bulb) causes wrong results. specialty=true: the product is only expected where a prior lists it explicitly (category or brand types); broad group values are damped to 15%.
